MINISTRY OF CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION 
(Department of Food and Public Distribution) 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 23rd May, 2022 
G.S.R. 384(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by clause (e) of sub-section (2) of section 39, 
read with section 
12, clause (d) of sub-section (4) of section 22 and section 38 of the National Food 
Security Act, 2013 (20 of 2013), the Central Government hereby makes the following rules further to 
amend the Food Security (Assistance to State Governments) Rules, 2015, namely:- 
1. (1) These rules may be called the Food Security (Assistance to State Governments) (Amendment) Rules, 
2022. 
(2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette.
